description: Implementation of the RandomDecoderTest class for testing HTTP/2 decoding with various segmentations and validation strategies.

classes.name: RandomDecoderTest
classes.description: A test class for decoding random segments of HTTP/2 data and validating the decoding process.

methods.name: StopDecodeOnDone
methods.description: Returns whether decoding should stop when decoding is done.

methods.name: DecodeSegments
methods.description: Decodes segments of data from a buffer, selecting segment sizes via a provided function.

methods.name: DecodeAndValidateSeveralWays
methods.description: Decodes and validates data multiple times with different segmentations, returning on first failure.

methods.name: SelectZeroAndOne
methods.description: Static method returning a segment size selector that alternates between zero and one.

methods.name: SelectRandom
methods.description: Static method returning a segment size selector that randomly chooses segment sizes.
